**🐛 Fix release** · Obsidian 1.11.4+ · desktop & mobile

"Start with a new chat" now also opens the panel, so you land directly in the new conversation — no extra swipe.

### 🌟 Highlights
- **The panel opens itself**: when Settings › Chat › "Start with a new chat" is set, M.I.L.A reveals the panel on launch and loads the new conversation in the chosen mode. Before, the conversation was ready but hidden behind a closed sidebar, so you still had to swipe it in.
- **Unchanged when off**: leaving the option on "Dashboard" keeps the previous behaviour — M.I.L.A stays closed and your saved layout is respected.

### 🔧 Fixes & Quality
- Panel reveal reuses the existing `activateView()`; nothing is opened unless the startup option is set.
- The chosen mode is still validated (`startupMode()`): an empty or unknown value opens the dashboard as before.
